headline: Banks: Interest Rate Spread Nearly Unchanged in July
summary: Deposit and lending interest rates in Greece remained almost unchanged in July. Bank of Greece data show weighted average rates on new loans and deposits were broadly stable.
why: Interest rate spreads between lending and deposit rates shape bank profitability. Central bank data on these rates are a key input for assessing credit conditions.
